pcof_hasfacesF_1bit.prc

The same cube as pcof_hasfacesT_6bit.prc, written by a nanoPRC writer changed
for this purpose in two places: has_faces is stored FALSE, and a single
is_point_color_on_face bit (1) comes before the point_color_array in place of
one per face. The geometry and colours are the same; the model tree names
differ (each file is named after itself).

This is the layout of prc-db's Castle_of_Bouvignes_Belgium_landscape (65,804
faces, has_faces FALSE, one bit). Adobe Acrobat and PDF-XChange Editor draw it
with all six colours (November 2026). The same cube with has_faces FALSE and six
bits, or has_faces TRUE and one bit, is refused by Acrobat and drawn without its
colours by PDF-XChange.

Used by tests/unit/test_point_color_on_face.c.
